maker.name: KTT
maker.about: KTT is the switch brand of Dongguan Content Electronics Co., Ltd. (东莞市康腾特电子有限公司) in Shipai, Dongguan, which states 20 years of experience making switch products.

switches.name: Purple Click

reviews.verdict: Budget click-jacket switch, KTT's second clicky design, reviewed as the KTT Purple Sauce from eastern sales listings.

sources.title: ThereminGoat: KTT Purple Sauce Switch Review

switches.notes: KTT spec card lists total travel as "4.0-5.0mm", so total travel is left open. ThereminGoat reviewed it as KTT Purple Sauce, a click-jacket switch.
